description: This file defines a specific locale/culture for date and time formatting and parsing in Faroese (fo-FO) language for the DateJS library. It includes localized names for days and months, formatting patterns, regex patterns for parsing, timezone info, and prototype extensions for date manipulation functions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a date to zero (midnight).

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of the date object to the current local time.
